# Operation authority and reference map
The canonical controller wire contract is [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml). Read [wire semantics](../build-spec/integrated/wire-api.md) with [integration precedence](../build-spec/INTEGRATION.md); W-D11 is superseded by [gateway identity](gateway-identity.md).
- All OP-001..OP-048 identities are mapped by each OpenAPI operation's `x-operation-ids`; aliases and WIRE transport additions are separate HTTP operations. - Method, path, header/query/body placement, required inputs, response status and typed errors are specified in OpenAPI, not generic handbook envelopes. - [Operation reference](../build-spec/VOL-E-operation-reference.md) supplies baseline algorithms/requirement traceability; disputed lifecycle/record details are gated in [INDEX §8](../build-spec/INDEX.md#8-integration-open-register--audit-g-gaps). - [Muster interface](../build-spec/integrated/cli-interface.md) specifies exact CLI/native commands and known MCP restrictions. There is no bespoke CHD CLI contract. - Provisioning uses explicit desired config and typed requests; [configuration](../build-spec/integrated/config-format.md) specifies authority/validation, [lifecycle](request-attempt-lifecycle.md) separates allocation and first turn. Native capability binding remains G-04/G-07.
A successful HTTP response or generated schema does not prove durable effects, authorization, runtime stop or independent buildability. Exact current release status is [VERDICT](../build-spec/VERDICT.md).
